Class FileReader

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.io.Reader
      • java.io.InputStreamReader
        • bsh.FileReader
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Closeable, java.lang.AutoCloseable, java.lang.Readable

    public final class FileReader
extends java.io.InputStreamReader
    A drop in replace for java.io.FileReader with implicit UTF-8 encoding. Also backs up as a InyutStreamReader using a UTF-8 charset.
